## Legs: run vs queued

### The engineering legs — RAN

- `api/src/api/release_serving.py` (new, ~470 lines): `ReleaseServingStore`
  over the mounted release registry — current-pointer resolution
  (`latest.json`), `?release=<pub>` for any promoted release, integrity-
  manifest digest pinning before any byte is served, per-request withdrawal
  re-evaluation (`route_access`), embedded-release-block agreement, typed
  `{detail, code}` refusals (404 `unknown_publication`/`scope_not_available`,
  410 `withdrawn`, 503 `release_artifact_absent`/`_unpinned`/
  `release_verification_failed`/`release_metadata_mismatch`/
  `no_current_release`/`release_serving_unconfigured`). Path segments are
  `[A-Za-z0-9._-]+`, never `.`/`..` — no scope escapes `api/`.
- `api/src/api/routes.py` re-classification: release-backed `/v1/dossier`,
  `/v1/coverage`, `/v1/export`, `/v1/changes`, `/v1/sources`,
  `/v1/sources/{id}` (new), `/v1/releases` + `/latest` + `/{pub}` (new);
  live-spine `/v1/resolution`, `/v1/entity`, `/v1/claim`, `/v1/evidence`,
  `/v1/contradiction`, `/v1/task`, `/v1/crosswalk`, `/v1/search` — each
  carrying the "newer than the site; not a citation" OpenAPI description.
  `?since=` on `/v1/changes` filters the release snapshot exactly as the
  spine feed. No-registry posture keeps today's live-spine answers on the
  dossier/coverage/export/changes routes (additive); the registry-only
  routes refuse `503 release_serving_unconfigured`.
- `api/src/api/basis_middleware.py`: the two-class stamper — handlers mark
  `scope["state"]` before answering so refusals carry the class that
  answered; `X-SIG-Basis: release` + `X-SIG-Release: <label> <pub>` +
  `X-SIG-Basis-Release: <pub>` and body `basis {kind, release{…}}` on the
  release class; `kind`/`as_of`/`spine_watermark`/`latest_release{}` added
  to the live-spine block with the P34.25 keys (`type`/`watermark`/
  `release_id`) kept. The release-namespaced FTS5 search route
  (`/v1/releases/{pub}/compartments/{comp}/search`) is marked release-basis —
  handler + both error paths.
- `api/src/api/app.py`: `/` + `/health` gain `release{}`, `code_commit`
  (`SIG_CODE_COMMIT`), `image` (`SIG_IMAGE_DIGEST`) — None = not pinned;
  `ReleaseServingError` → typed JSON + `Retry-After: 5` on 503;
  `release_serving` defaults to the `release_search` registry.
- `api/src/api/cli.py`: `sig-api serve --release-registry` also resolves
  `SIG_RELEASE_REGISTRY` (env for the Cloud Run mount path).
- `ops/src/ops/release_publish_verify.py`: `PF.api_parity` (V7) refuses an
  unservable promotion — wrong schema/foreign index, documents outside
  `r/<pub>/api/`, unpinned/absent/unparseable/foreign-stamped documents,
  staged dossier pages the slice does not cover, api files with no index;
  no-slice releases with no parity-bound pages record `deferred` (owner +
  landing named), never a pass.
- Fixture registry `tests/api/fixtures/release_registry/`: two promoted
  publications, catalog/latest/withdrawals, integrity manifests, a full
  `p-aa…` api slice + one `p-bb…` dossier document.
- Tests: `tests/api/test_api_release_parity.py` (29);
  `tests/ops/test_release_publish_verify.py` +8 (V7 matrix incl. the
  committed-candidate `deferred` path).
